windows.notes:
Safer handling of file names in what ucopy writes and sends.
- Discord and Slack alerts no longer ping anyone: a file named @everyone or <!channel> is shown as text.
- Line breaks and terminal codes in file names are shown as escapes (\n, \x1b) in logs, reports, alerts and the command line, so a name can't fake a log line or affect a terminal.
- Opening a folder from ucopy only ever opens a folder.
- Choosing ucopy in Explorer's menu while a job runs no longer drops an earlier request.

macos.notes:
Fixes for disk images.
- An image of a disk that was interrupted now carries on where it stopped, instead of reading the whole disk again (which wears a failing disk). It first checks a few sectors, so another disk at the same place, or an image damaged since, is imaged again.
- An image that can't be opened is never carried on in a new, empty file.
- Image a disk: the snapshot option now says that free space isn't read.
